description.narrative: To reduce public perception of and opportunities for economic corruption through improvements to economic governance, thereby encouraging investment in Kosovo's economy. This will be achieved by 1)improving the business environment, 2) strengthening public financial management, and 3) enhancing strategic communication (cross-cutting).
